problem_text:
Select all the situations that can be represented by the tape diagram.
[image]

Answer choices:
A. Noah walked a family’s dog 5 times this past month and earned the same amount each time. To thank him
B. the family gave him an extra $6 at the end of the month. Noah earned $106 from dog walking. || A family of 5 drove to a soccer game. They paid $6 for parking
C. and all of their tickets were the same price. They paid $106 in total. || 5 bags of coins each contain 6 nickels and the same number of pennies. Altogether
D. the bags contain 106 coins. || Kiran is baking 5 batches of muffins. Each batch needs the same amount of sugar in the muffins
E. and each batch needs six extra teaspoons of sugar for the topping. Kiran uses 106 total teaspoons of sugar. || Priya buys 5 cases of water
F. each with the same number of bottles. The store clerk gives her an extra 6 bottles before she leaves. She leaves with a total of 106 bottles.
